newsitem.title: USA: Walt Disney Co Q1 share $1.09.
newsitem.headline: Walt Disney Co Q1 share $1.09.

text.p: (Unaudited; in millions, except per share data)

NOTE: (1) During the quarter, Disney sold KCAL, a Los Angeles TV station, which resulted in a gain of $135 million. Excluding the gain on the sale of KCAL, operating income increased 20% to $1.4 billion, net income increased 18% to $669 million, and earnings per share increased 20% to $0.98.

Results for the prior-year quarter on an as reported basis do not reflect the acquisition of ABC, which became effective on February 9, 1996. To enhance comparability, operating results for the quarter ended December 31, 1995 have been presented on a pro forma basis which assumes the acquisition of ABC occurred at the beginning of such period. The following discussion reflects pro forma operating results for the prior year.
First Call consensus estimates for Disney's first quarter were $0.94 a share.
